canonical_unit_system.conversion_policy: Preserve source units and exact conversion in every adapter record; reject implicit units.

modules.purpose: Freeze aircraft mass, velocity, attitude, trajectory and contact-time envelopes.
modules.solver_or_method: deterministic SI-unit transformations and geometry checks
modules.validation_gate: V8S input hashes and geometric time-scale checks pass; no damage credit.
modules.stop_condition: Missing provenance, non-SI conversion record, or attempt to infer member damage.

modules.purpose: Transform impact conditions into member damage, openings, debris and fuel distributions.
modules.implementation: schema only; V9M closes the current physical solver branch as unqualified
modules.solver_or_method: future qualified explicit dynamics; OpenRadioss is only installation-smoke qualified
inputs: aircraft and tower high-rate material/joint cards
modules.validation_gate: All V9M primary-evidence and convergence triggers plus energy/mass balance.
modules.stop_condition: Any unqualified erosion, mesh dependence, missing CF6-80A2 card, or absent as-built mesh.

modules.purpose: Compute or bracket gas temperature and heat-flux histories after impact.
modules.implementation: schema plus bounded surrogate inputs; exact NIST FDS event inputs unavailable
modules.solver_or_method: future FDS or explicitly labelled reduced fire envelope
modules.validation_gate: Mass/energy conservation, mesh/time sensitivity and comparison to bounded observations or published official-model envelopes.
modules.stop_condition: Damage/fire interface lacks provenance or a surrogate is mislabeled as an FDS event reconstruction.

modules.purpose: Map gas exposure through protection and conduction to member temperature histories.
modules.implementation: V8E synthetic fields preserve official extrema but are not member-resolved NIST temperatures
modules.solver_or_method: reduced thermal map; future validated solid heat-transfer solver
modules.validation_gate: Temperature extrema, conservation, time-step convergence and member/source mapping.
modules.stop_condition: Synthetic spatial field is treated as measured or as an event probability.

modules.purpose: Establish the post-impact gravity state before heating.
modules.implementation: V8H/V8J/V8L/V8R reduced graph and capacity diagnostics
modules.validation_gate: All 22 V10A source requirements plus equilibrium and displacement compatibility.
modules.stop_condition: Disconnected loaded component, failed equilibrium, or proxy capacity presented as as-built.

modules.purpose: Combine prestress and temperature-dependent response to test initiation or survival.
modules.solver_or_method: future coupled or sequential structural solver with validated material/connection laws
modules.validation_gate: Cold equilibrium, thermal mapping, numerical convergence and component benchmarks all pass.
modules.stop_condition: Any upstream physical gate is closed or instability depends on an unbounded proxy.

modules.purpose: Test whether an initiated local descent propagates, arrests, or remains indeterminate.
modules.implementation: not yet implemented; deliberately separate from initiation
modules.solver_or_method: future energy-momentum/member-removal bracket with optional explicit verification
modules.validation_gate: Energy and momentum close, time-step/element sensitivity passes, and arrest control cases reproduce.
modules.stop_condition: Initiation is assumed to imply global propagation, or conservation residual exceeds the declared tolerance.

modules.purpose: Run declared parameter envelopes and preserve outcome classifications without converting them to real-event probabilities.
modules.solver_or_method: deterministic case grid and seeded sampling
modules.validation_gate: Fixed seeds, complete manifests, unit checks, replay equality and explicit probability prohibition.
modules.stop_condition: Synthetic fraction is reported as probability of the historical event.

modules.purpose: Render only released states and uncertainty labels for human inspection.
modules.solver_or_method: Blender; no rigid-body, fracture, fluid or structural feedback credit
uncertainties: displayed as separate scenarios or envelopes, never hidden interpolation
modules.validation_gate: Source-state hashes, transform reproduction, mandatory banner and no post-contact invention.
modules.stop_condition: A blocked state is animated as prediction or Blender output feeds a mechanical result.

interfaces.spatial_mapping: aircraft frame to tower impact coordinate frame
interfaces.temporal_mapping: absolute event time; contact reference t=0 s
interfaces.uncertainty_transfer: preserve mass/speed/attitude intervals and source class without averaging
interfaces.validation_gate: SI units, transform round trip, source hashes and V9M physical triggers
interfaces.stop_condition: adapter may serialize the envelope but must emit PHYSICS_BLOCKED instead of damage

interfaces.spatial_mapping: structural member/opening IDs to fire mesh compartments/cells
interfaces.temporal_mapping: post-impact state at declared handoff time
interfaces.validation_gate: mass conservation, geometry containment and physical impact qualification
interfaces.stop_condition: no exact damage state may be fabricated from a kinematic envelope

interfaces.spatial_mapping: damage IDs must resolve one-to-one to the structural catalogue
interfaces.temporal_mapping: equilibrated cold state before thermal continuation
interfaces.validation_gate: identifier coverage, equilibrium, displacement compatibility and 22/22 source closure
interfaces.stop_condition: unresolved member IDs or disconnected loaded components

interfaces.spatial_mapping: conservative cell/surface to member-face exposure map
interfaces.temporal_mapping: monotone time interpolation with no extrapolation beyond declared bounds
interfaces.uncertainty_transfer: fire scenario ID and correlated time history preserved
interfaces.validation_gate: unit/range checks, conservative mapping and heat-flux/time integral audit
interfaces.stop_condition: temperature-only surrogate may not be relabeled as measured heat flux

interfaces.spatial_mapping: every thermal member ID resolves to one structural element/section
interfaces.temporal_mapping: shared monotone time grid or declared energy-preserving resampling
interfaces.validation_gate: ID coverage, Kelvin bounds, time-grid audit and temperature-dependent law provenance
interfaces.stop_condition: missing member map or use of synthetic fields as exact member temperatures

interfaces.spatial_mapping: identical structural IDs and coordinate frame
interfaces.temporal_mapping: cold equilibrium is initial state at thermal time zero
interfaces.validation_gate: equilibrium tolerance, displacement compatibility and 22/22 source closure
interfaces.stop_condition: failed or indeterminate cold gate cannot seed a physical thermal run

interfaces.spatial_mapping: full state projection onto the separately validated propagation model
interfaces.temporal_mapping: handoff at a declared instability event with conserved state
interfaces.uncertainty_transfer: initiation alternatives remain separate propagation cases
interfaces.validation_gate: mass/momentum/energy ledger and state-projection error tolerances
interfaces.stop_condition: initiation alone must never be reported as proof of global propagation

interfaces.spatial_mapping: story/member outcome IDs retained without aggregation loss
interfaces.temporal_mapping: complete history or declared terminal event
interfaces.uncertainty_transfer: epistemic and aleatory variables stored in separate fields
interfaces.validation_gate: manifest completeness, deterministic replay and probability-language audit
interfaces.stop_condition: fraction of synthetic cases must not be called real-event probability

interfaces.spatial_mapping: solver/reduced coordinates to Blender coordinates with reversible transform
interfaces.temporal_mapping: explicit time/frame mapping; blocked intervals may use cards only
interfaces.uncertainty_transfer: show separate envelopes/scenarios and permanent labels
interfaces.validation_gate: hashes, transform round trip, mandatory banner, no physics feedback
interfaces.stop_condition: blocked state or post-contact invention must freeze or render as a data card

release_bus_rule: Only records with an explicit validation_status, epistemic_class and source hashes can reach the ensemble or Blender. Blocked records may be carried only as labelled null/control states.
causal_scope_rule: Passing one interface validates only its serialization and declared mapping. It does not validate upstream physics, downstream physics or the whole historical chain.
